general_endpoint_mode.description: Behavior when an owner-restricted user requests a general/collection endpoint: 'filter' transparently scopes results to records they own, 'reject' returns 403

should_restrict_access_to_owner.description: Restrict non-admin users to records they own (devices, CDRs); admins are unaffected

should_restrict_access_to_unowned.description: Also hide records with no owner_id from owner-restricted users
